description: Forward an already-signed Fusion order to 1inch's relayer. The signature is the user's authorization; this server never signs and never holds a key. Pass the `order`, `signature`, `extension` and `quoteId` returned by trdefi_fusion_prepare. A resolver fills the order later; submission does not guarantee a fill.

extension.description: The `extension` returned by trdefi_fusion_prepare. Defaults to 0x.

order.description: The signed Fusion order object returned by trdefi_fusion_prepare (`order`).

signature.description: EIP-712 signature from the wallet (0x-prefixed hex).

name: trdefi_fusion_submit
title: Submit a signed Fusion order
